bluf: Kuno Creative is an employee owned US B2B agency and HubSpot Diamond Partner selling revenue driven marketing to midmarket manufacturers and technology firms: pipeline, RevOps, brand, websites, HubSpot builds and, on top, AI consulting and AEO/GEO. Its house is busy, with 30 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 17 LinkedIn ads, and its September 2026 posts point toward deeper HubSpot credentials and AI citation work. A rival should know it sells AI visibility with published AI referral results, yet publishes no llms.txt and shows no audited citation product.
doing:
The positioning line describes an employee owned, HubSpot centric B2B agency selling revenue driven marketing through human led, AI accelerated systems for pipeline, RevOps, brand and websites. In plain words: it builds and runs HubSpot marketing for midmarket B2B firms and now sells AI setup and AI search on top. The headline claim, quoted as a claim: 25+ years in B2B revenue growth, 500+ B2B brands served, HubSpot Diamond Partner.

The mix is broad, breadth 11, with B2B & ABM leading at score 3 on a title and H1 selling B2B marketing built to win deals and predictable pipeline. Five more lines are core at 2: AI Automation / Agents (an AI consulting program and HubSpot AI readiness), AI Search / GEO (an AEO service page, a results index and a manufacturer AI search case), Content & Digital PR, Email & CRM (HubSpot implementation, migration and CRM integration) and Web & Product (a website design page). Data & Measurement, Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic & CTV and SEO score 1. Proprietary: an AI Readiness Score, Power Pages (a pillar structure AEO method) and a three phase AI program (Get AI Ready, Go To Market, Full Partnership). The one partner is HubSpot, Diamond tier.

AI posture in plain terms: human led, AI accelerated; it sells AI consulting, HubSpot AI readiness built on Breeze and custom agents, and AEO/GEO with published AI referral results.

The record lists no dated moves, news or open jobs (its Workable board shows 0). The dated trail is its blog: 3 HubSpot accreditations (2026-09-11), three HubSpot badges (2026-09-15), a guide to getting cited in AI overviews and answer engines (2026-09-21) and a post on system to system integrations (2026-09-24). Pricing: a page promises flexible options tailored to goals and budget, with no figures. Conspicuously absent for a B2B demand gen agency: an ABM stack or testing tool on its own site, and feed, schema or entity work.
clients:
Kuno Creative serves midmarket B2B firms in industrial manufacturing, technology and SaaS, medical device and MedTech, and sustainability, from the US, with no office listed.

The needs read codes 4 clients: 4 observed and 0 names only, each from a case study. AAON, a commercial HVAC manufacturer, came to scale its brand through integrated marketing (brand and creative, local and lead generation). TSS, a bulletproofing solutions manufacturer, came for revenue growth through paid advertising (paid performance, brand and creative, and commerce and marketplaces, which the excerpt does not describe). Remington-Davis (RDI) came for a video campaign to build trust with patients and sponsors (brand and creative, local and lead generation). The fourth, e2Companies, an energy solutions provider, came for a new identity with branding and trade show support (brand and creative, plus an undescribed data and measurement code). Brand and creative carries a 0.553 share of the mix.

The case study index, 39 deep, names others the needs read does not code: Fujifilm (a 259% increase in its contact database from lead generation), Saint Leo University (website experience and demand generation), Skyven Technologies and The Groove (+150% ranked keywords). Its unnamed cases claim 103% more leads for a technology company, 900+ MQLs and $209M in opportunities for a professional services provider, and a 24% cut in acquisition cost for a retirement care provider. A LinkedIn ad features Inspirus in a LinkedIn Live about working with Kuno. No client is shared with another tracked agency.

Next need, as a judgment: Horus names KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) its main tailwind, so it is likely, moderate confidence, that these firms will ask next for proof that AI answers cite them, measured as citation share; Kuno sells AEO/GEO but the record shows no audited citation product.
house: Say and do: 2 of 3 tested lines hold, integrity 66.7 on the Horus read. AI Search / GEO is contradicted: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, with 5 AI topic URLs in its sitemap. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: its LinkedIn Ad Library record shows 17 ads, all company page ads, 0 thought leader ads, with lines such as 'An analysis of 89,000 LinkedIn posts reveals what AI search tools cite and what they skip.' Publishing cadence is corroborated: the sitemap lists 644 URLs, 30 updated in 90 days and 60 in 365. Its Transparency Center record shows 2 Google text ads under Kuno Creative Group, LLC, 0 in the last 30 days, last shown 2026-07-30. The site runs HubSpot CMS with gtm and the LinkedIn Insight tag; no test tools or ABM stack are recorded. No AI crawler is blocked. Meta and TikTok status is not recorded.
market:
Horus puts Kuno Creative at a tailwind index of 18.1, band Favored, 67th percentile, resilience 31.7, Solar Arc 16:30, dusk (Atum). Best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation), net 0.292, driven by AI Search / GEO and Content & Digital PR against SEO, and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers scale faster than any channel before them), net 0.146. Monsoon reads 50.8, band Breeze, 31st percentile, displacement 53.3 above migration 48.3. The verdict puts 48 of it on the sold mix, Web & Product (10) and Content & Digital PR (6) carrying the most movable hours. Shore: 0.65 Asia (South Asia 0.35, Southeast Asia 0.3), 0.25 Latin America, 0.1 Eastern Europe. Footprint inferred: no hub office, no onshore claim; the midmarket ICP term adds 5 points.
openings:
The strongest opening is its own AI visibility claim. Kuno sells AEO/GEO with published AI referral results, yet its house publishes no llms.txt beside 5 AI topic URLs, and the record shows no audited citation product (tracking, scorecard, citation share). A rival that leads with an audited citation share number for a prospect's category, practised on its own site, is likely, moderate confidence, to win AI search mandates from Kuno's manufacturers and technology firms. Falsifier: an llms.txt and a citation tracking or scorecard product on Kuno's site at the next compile.

The machine readable layer is unclaimed: no feed, schema or entity work shows, a gap that matters most to manufacturers with product catalogues (inferred). Its offer rests on one platform, HubSpot CMS on its own site, a Diamond tier partnership and Breeze agents, so firms on other CRMs are likely the easier ground for a platform neutral rival (low confidence). With pricing described only as flexible options, a published, outcome priced pipeline offer is a conversation it cannot have in public. Its lead line, B2B & ABM, shows no ABM stack on its own site: a question to put in the pitch.
watch: Indicator I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: search growth below 10% flags cannibalization and would strengthen KJ1, Kuno's main tailwind through AI Search / GEO.

Indicator I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth would confirm the UGC starvation risk under KJ1 that its content line depends on.

Indicator I1, Comscore monthly AI prompt share, Q3 report expected around December 2026: Gemini at or above 40% or ChatGPT at or below 45% favors S1 and decides which assistants its AEO/GEO work must reach.

Indicator I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the next milestone ($2B) and CPM below $20 bear on KJ2, a tailwind it holds through AI Search and Paid Search without testing ads inside assistants (P8 absent).

The dated moves to follow up are its HubSpot accreditation and badge posts of 2026-09-11 and 2026-09-15: a new partner tier or AI credential would deepen the HubSpot dependency a rival pitches against.
The next Radar compile after 2026-09-28 should show whether an llms.txt appears, whether its Google ads, last shown 2026-07-30, return, and whether the Workable board posts any role.
